# apple-dns.net
> Apple DNS provides DNS, DDNS, and domain registration services with customer support, account management, and service information.

Apple DNS appears to be a hosting and DNS services site focused on domain registration, DNS management, dynamic DNS, and customer account operations.

## Main Site
- [Home](https://apple-dns.net/): Main landing page for Apple DNS services and account access.
- [Contact](https://apple-dns.net/contact): Customer contact page for support and service inquiries.
- [Support](https://apple-dns.net/support): Support entry point for customer assistance and service help.
- [Login](https://apple-dns.net/login): Customer login page for account access and service management.

## Account & Customer Access
- [Client Area](https://apple-dns.net/clientarea.php): Customer dashboard for managing services, billing, and account details.
- [Login](https://apple-dns.net/clientarea.php): Sign in page for existing customers to access their accounts.
- [Register](https://apple-dns.net/register.php): Account registration page for new customers.
- [Password Reset](https://apple-dns.net/pwreset.php): Password recovery page for customer account access.

## Domain Services
- [Domain Checker](https://apple-dns.net/domainchecker.php): Search and check availability for domain name registrations.
- [Domain Registration](https://apple-dns.net/cart.php?a=add&domain=register): Start a new domain registration order.
- [Domain Transfer](https://apple-dns.net/cart.php?a=add&domain=transfer): Transfer an existing domain to Apple DNS.
- [Domain Pricing](https://apple-dns.net/domainchecker.php): Review supported domain search and registration options.

## DNS & Hosting Services
- [Order Services](https://apple-dns.net/cart.php): Service ordering page for DNS and related products.
- [Dynamic DNS](https://apple-dns.net/cart.php): Service catalog entry point for DDNS-related offerings.
- [DNS Hosting](https://apple-dns.net/cart.php): Service ordering area for DNS hosting products.
- [View Cart](https://apple-dns.net/cart.php?a=view): Review selected services before checkout.

## Billing & Orders
- [Announcements](https://apple-dns.net/announcements.php): Service announcements, updates, and customer notices.
- [Knowledgebase](https://apple-dns.net/knowledgebase.php): Help articles for common service and account questions.
- [Downloads](https://apple-dns.net/downloads.php): Downloadable files, tools, or customer resources.
- [Server Status](https://apple-dns.net/serverstatus.php): Current operational status for hosted services and infrastructure.

## Support Resources
- [Submit Ticket](https://apple-dns.net/submitticket.php): Open a support request for technical or account issues.
- [Support Tickets](https://apple-dns.net/supporttickets.php): View and manage existing customer support tickets.
- [Knowledgebase](https://apple-dns.net/knowledgebase.php): Browse support documentation and troubleshooting articles.
- [Network Status](https://apple-dns.net/serverstatus.php): Check service availability and infrastructure status.

## News & Updates
- [Announcements](https://apple-dns.net/announcements.php): Official news, maintenance notices, and service updates.
- [Downloads](https://apple-dns.net/downloads.php): Customer-facing downloads and related service files.
- [Knowledgebase](https://apple-dns.net/knowledgebase.php): Reference material for setup and service usage.
- [Contact](https://apple-dns.net/contact.php): Reach Apple DNS for support or business questions.

## Legal & Policies
- [Terms of Service](https://apple-dns.net/tos.php): Terms governing use of Apple DNS services and accounts.
- [Privacy Policy](https://apple-dns.net/privacy.php): Privacy practices for customer data and site usage.
- [Contact](https://apple-dns.net/contact.php): Official contact information for policy and service questions.
- [Home](https://apple-dns.net/): Starting point for navigating service and policy information.
